name: Soft UI (neumorphism)
fit: Extruded soft shadows; consumer/low-density only—watch contrast.
feel: Tactile, soft, embossed into the canvas.
type: Rounded sans; medium weights for contrast.
color: Monochrome soft surfaces; accents used sparingly.
bestFor: Simple consumer controls, wellness, low-density settings.
avoid: Dense data, WCAG-critical primary actions without extra contrast.
adapt: Raise contrast on text and CTAs; keep soft only as texture.
